exposure: Type of surgical condition (general vs. gynecologic)
outcome: Prevalence of specific conditions requiring surgery
Trends in surgical methods over time
cohort: The study cohort comprised 101 pregnant patients who underwent non-obstetric surgery at a single hospital in South Korea between 2006 and 2023.
finding: Laparoscopic surgery during pregnancy resulted in shorter operative times and hospital stays compared to open surgery, with an increasing trend in its use across all trimesters since 2011.
